---
name: build-ui
description: Build or modify UI in this project using its existing components and conventions.
---

# Build UI

- Inspect relevant component exports and source files before composing UI or creating a new component.
- Reuse existing components when they fit; add abstractions only when they solve a real need.
- Follow the applicable repository instructions for TSX, CSS modules, typography, and imports.
- Adapt the layout and styling to the request; treat examples and existing pages as references, not required templates.
- Run a focused check for the changed UI when available.
